items.quote: Rich people love showing off their wealth with flashy possessions.
items.statement: Rich people show off wealth with flashy possessions; wealthy people focus on long-term financial health.

items.quote: Wealth isn't about what you can buy today, it's about building a future.
items.statement: It's about building a future where you don't have to worry about money.

items.quote: It's about long-term financial health and making smart investments.
items.statement: Focus on making smart investments for long-term financial health.

items.quote: Being wealthy is having lots of time.
items.statement: Being wealthy is about having lots of time.

items.quote: Or, as I like to say, "Rich is buying a fancy car; wealthy is owning the road!"
items.statement: The post uses a playful tone to convey its message about wealth.

overview: A LinkedIn post discussing the distinction between being rich and being wealthy.
